open_points.subject: load_configuration
open_points.text:
- Reflective attribute access is rejected: never call getattr, hasattr,
  setattr, delattr, or vars; a declared field or operation is
  addressed by its name, including in try/finally cleanup, and a
  model's fields are read generically only by iterating the model.
open_points.other_text: - load_configuration: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST check the settings load_runtime_settings answers in this order and answer a StartDiagnostic at the first check that fails, naming the failed check and the failed item by its RuntimeSettings field name, the equal-secrets check both items of the first equal pair in that order, the check that the two ports differ the service_listen item alone, and never a value, items within one check taken in the order the model declares them, each item and its field name taken from the pairs model_items answers for the settings and matched by name with the names the imported constants hold, no field read by a name held as text: the items the imported RUNTIME_SETTINGS_ALL_OR_NONE constant names all set or all unset, a partial set failing on its first unset item; each item the imported RUNTIME_SETTINGS_REQUIRED constant names set; each address well formed; the two addresses' ports different; each secret at least the imported SECRET_MIN_BYTES constant in bytes of its text encoded by the imported TEXT_ENCODING constant, a secret whose text cannot be so encoded failing that check for its item, so that no setting makes the check raise; no two secrets equal; the store and the backup location apart.
open_points.question: Must load_configuration read the model's fields by directly iterating the model, or must it obtain them from model_items; alternatively, must the static gate explicitly recognize model_items as the permitted generic iteration mechanism?
